entries.title: MCP + OAuth 2.1 AI Platform
entries.technologies: Python, FastAPI, OAuth 2.1 / OIDC, Model Context Protocol, MongoDB, Redis, Terraform, AWS ECS
entries.description: Lead author of Veltra's platform exposing the travel-activity catalog to AI assistants — a standards-compliant OAuth 2.1 authorization server (Clean Architecture) plus MCP servers dual-compatible with Claude and ChatGPT apps.

entries.title: WareX — Logistics SaaS API
entries.technologies: Go, Echo, GORM, MySQL, JWT/RBAC, Minio/S3, GKE, CircleCI
entries.description: Senior backend engineer and top-3 author on the Go API of WareX, a production logistics 'warehouse-exchange' SaaS at Gaussy — owned the warehouse, contract, workspace, document and pricing verticals plus the team's integration-test harness.

entries.title: golem — LINE-bot Fund Analytics
entries.technologies: Ruby on Rails 5, React, JSON:API, LINE Messaging API, gnuplot
entries.description: Lead author of a multi-tenant Rails 5 + React platform that delivers fund and bond analytics (net-asset-value graphs, factor analysis) to users as LINE Flex Messages and generated charts, with HMAC webhook verification, at Robotfund.

entries.title: bumblebee — Race-free TTS Caching Service
entries.technologies: Go, CSP concurrency, LAME (PCM→MP3), Docker, AWS
entries.description: Solo Go service fronting a pool of text-to-speech servers — race-free by design (channel-owned state), with PCM-to-MP3 transcoding, content-digest caching and per-host load distribution, verified with `go test -race`, at Robotfund.

entries.title: Reuters Market-Data Pipeline
entries.technologies: Go, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Reuters DataScope Select
entries.description: Solo Go AWS Lambda that ingests daily Reuters DataScope Select market data into an idempotent DynamoDB/S3 state machine, built on an extracted MIT-licensed Reuters DSS Go client library, at Robotfund.

entries.title: FupIntuition — IoT/Edge People Analytics
entries.technologies: Go (amd64 + ARM), BLE beacons, WiFi sniffing, HashiCorp Vault, GPG-signed OTA, S3 apt repo
entries.description: Sole author of an end-to-end Go daemon for in-store edge devices — staff counting via BLE, repeat-customer counting via WiFi, and face recognition — with a web UI and a full signed over-the-air update pipeline, at Allm.

entries.title: FAST-ED Clinical Triage API
entries.technologies: Ruby, Grape, GraphQL, Pundit, HMAC, bcrypt
entries.description: Lead author of a versioned stroke/cardiac triage API for hospitals (Grape + GraphQL + Pundit) with HMAC request signing and hardened authentication, plus its Vue 2 + Apollo admin SPA, at Allm.

entries.title: Griffon — Mobile MMORPG Backend
entries.technologies: Ruby, Padrino, ActiveRecord, MySQL, Resque, RSpec
entries.description: Backend engineer on the live Ruby/Padrino backend of the published mobile MMORPG 'Griffon' (幻塔戦記グリフォン, Japan + Korea) — independently owned the achievements, friendship, reward-distribution and guild-battle matchmaking systems with database-level idempotency, at Aiming.

entries.title: IronFunctions — Open-source Serverless Platform
entries.technologies: Go, Docker, Vue, Express, JWT, CircleCI
entries.description: Open-source contributor to IronFunctions, an early Docker-based FaaS platform (later the Fn Project) — added JWT auth and the CI/CD release pipeline to its web UI and contributed engine features such as a payload-as-stdin runner, at iron.io.

entries.title: This Résumé Site
entries.technologies: ReScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, PDFKit, docx
entries.description: A static, multilingual (EN/JA/TR) résumé site prerendered to HTML, generating language-specific PDF and DOCX résumés at build time from a single content source, deployed to GitHub Pages.
